title: test: prune UI tests that can't catch a bug, fix two that couldn't fail

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Test-only change; both rewritten assertions were checked against the code they assert and can now fail.
<sub>no findings · tests not needed · risk low</sub>

Test-only cleanup: drops lab and ELK option-pin tests and rewrites two assertions that could never fail. Both rewritten checks are sound against the current code; safe to merge.

- Legend-slot test records the hook's first-render answer instead of an always-non-empty DOM string
- local-ui traces row test asserts the row's `Trace GET /` link instead of the text "1"

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `role("link", { name: "Trace GET /" })` matches: `rowLink` sets `aria-label` to `Trace ${rootSpanName}` (`view-row.ts:31`)
- `usePlotLegendSlot` returns `slot !== null && items !== null` during render (`plot-frame.tsx:452`), so `answers[0]` is `true`
- Removing the lab/ELK tests leaves every remaining file balanced and free of unused imports (`Mount`, `text`, `click` still used)

</details>

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Test-only change: both rewritten assertions were checked against the hook's first-render return and the row link's `aria-label`, and each can now fail.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk low</sub>

Removes UI tests that duplicated covered behaviour or pinned layout option strings, and replaces two assertions that could never fail with ones that can. Test-only and safe to merge.

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `usePlotLegendSlot` derives its answer at render (`plot-frame.tsx:452`), so `answers[0]` is `true` and a read-back-from-effect regression now fails the test
- `role("link", { name: "Trace GET /" })` matches the row's `aria-label` built from `rootSpanName` (`view-row.ts:31`, `row-link.ts:27`)
- The removed ELK assertions were constant-vs-literal pins on `DEFAULT_LAYOUT_CONFIG`, which the repo's `test-slop` rules ban; the flat/compound and >300-node switch checks stay

</details>
